depmap.scope: Independent CRISPR single-gene dependency, parental cell models; not acquired-resistant HCT116-R/SW480-R and not combination effects.

tcga.scope: Tumor/normal expression context; treatment response and oxaliplatin resistance are not inferred.

single_cell.normalization: log1p(UMI / all-gene cell library size * 10000); equal patient averaging
single_cell.scope: Published cell labels retained; epithelial tumor-tissue location is not a new malignant-cell call or resistance-state measurement.

string.operator: Binary thresholded adjacency with self-loops and symmetric degree normalization.

metabolic_flux.normalization: Divide each state bound by its HCC_biomass minimum, following author normalize_growth; log1p(max(abs(lower),abs(upper))), then equal mean over linked reactions.
metabolic_flux.mapping: HCT_GEM.mat rxnGeneMat association -> HGNC Ensembl symbols; only exact shared reaction identifiers. GPR AND/OR semantics are not used to simulate knockout.
metabolic_flux.scope: Author thermodynamic model feasible bounds constrained by metabolomics, not measured intracellular fluxes, statistical intervals, or gene-knockout effects. Clean snapshot reanalysis; not a reproduction of every published figure.

epigenetic_map.summary: Union of +/-2000bp windows around all exact-symbol RefGene TSS; count unique overlapping author MACS2 peaks and maximum fold enrichment, log1p transformed.
epigenetic_map.scope: Six deposited processed peak tracks, one per mark/state. No replicate-based differential-binding test; missing called peak is not proof of absent modification. Differences are descriptive, with no cross-sample spike-in calibration. These HCT116/OxR lines are not assumed identical to collaborators or the separate flux study.

normalization: Training-node moments fitted separately per split; missing values standardized to zero with explicit missing indicators.
